caseNameFull: ALABAMA LEGISLATIVE BLACK CAUCUS v. ALABAMA

opinions.text: Appeals from the United States District Court for the Middle District of Alabama. In this case probable jurisdiction noted limited to Question 2 presented by the statement as to jurisdiction in No. 13-895 and Question 1 presented by the statement as to jurisdiction in No. 13-1138. The case *2696is consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
